sentences.en: The yacht was at the mercy of the dreadful storm.
sentences.zh: 那艘游艇在可怕的暴风雨中任由摆布。

sentences.en: He could not go out because of a bad storm.
sentences.zh: 由于一场糟糕的暴风雨，他无法外出。

sentences.en: The house had its roof ripped off by the storm.
sentences.zh: 房子被风暴掀掉了屋顶。

senses.zh: 起风暴；横冲直撞；狂怒咆哮
